en.content: Consider an arithmetic series and a geometric series having four initial terms from the set {11, 8, 21, 16, 26, 32, 4}. If the last terms of these series are the maximum possible four digit numbers, then the number of common terms in these two series is equal to ___________.
en.explanation:
A.P. from the set will be 11, 16, 21, 26 .....

G.P. from the set will be 4, 8, 16, 32, 64, 128, 256, 512, 1024, 2048, 4096, 8192 .....

So common terms are 16, 256, 4096.
